title: Holidays
descriptionFa: انواع سفر، وسیله‌های رفت‌وآمد، چیزهایی که باید همراهت باشه، و عبارت‌های سفر.

words.example: Our summer holiday in Ramsar was wonderful.
words.tipFa: آمریکایی‌ها vacation می‌گن. holiday به روز تعطیل رسمی هم می‌گن.

words.example: Sorry, Mr Ahmadi is on holiday until Sunday.
Where do you want to go on holiday this year?
words.tipFa: go on holiday، نه go to holiday.

words.meaningFa: تور کامل (پرواز و هتل با هم)
words.example: A package holiday is easy because someone else books everything.
Our flight to Istanbul leaves at six in the morning.
Every spring we go camping in the forest near Gorgan.
Last spring we went on a walking holiday in the Alamut valley.
My grandparents went on a coach tour of Turkey.
It's quicker to go by plane.
words.tipFa: با by و بدون a: by plane, by train, by car.

words.example: We travelled from Tehran to Mashhad by train.
You can take the ferry from Bandar Abbas to Qeshm.
The coach to Shiraz takes about twelve hours.
words.tipFa: اتوبوس داخل شهر می‌شه bus. coach معنی «مربی» هم می‌ده.

words.example: Check that your passport is still valid before you book.
Iranians need a visa to visit many European countries.
Have you got your ticket? Show it at the gate.
Change some money into the local currency at the airport.
We have too much luggage for this small car.
words.tipFa: غیرقابل‌شمارشه: much luggage، نه luggages. یکی‌ش: a piece of luggage.

words.example: I always travel with just a rucksack.
We're going to fly to Dubai on Friday.
When I travel, I always try the local food.
Young tourists come here to enjoy the nightlife.
Have a great time in Isfahan!
words.tipFa: موقع خداحافظی با کسی که می‌ره سفر یا مهمونی.

words.example: I bought a postcard of Persepolis for my teacher.
